listing.name: Heart of Darkness (hode)
listing.summary: Research listing. Upstream route: Native engine rewrite with explicit original Windows data set and paths. Limits: Observed release assets only Switch/Vita; desktop build/package route needs follow-up. Upstream platforms: Desktop source-build route; observed release binaries are Switch/Vita only. No established desktop package or desktop CPU artifact in frozen research. Original data: Supply original Heart of Darkness Windows release data, from the Demo or CD: hod.paf (or hod_demo.paf/hod_demo2.paf), setup.dat and matching *_hod.lvl, *_hod.sss and *_hod.mst files. Demo data provides demo content, not the full game. Exact localization/revision is not pinned in the retained README. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
